names.note: Name page 770 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Еллий Египетский, прп.»; the rank is stripped. The day line declines him as «Еллия монаха, Египетского».

death.note: The reading opens «Преподобный Еллий жил и скончался в IV веке» and the day line closes «(IV)». No year anywhere, and the century is the whole of what the source gives.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 июля ст. ст. — «Прп. Еллия монаха, Египетского (IV).»

attestations.note: The day's fourth entry. No folder held him: `fk.mjs` on «Еллий Египетский» returns NONE and no `saints/hellius*` or `saints/helius*` folder exists, nor does any folder in this corpus carry «Еллий» in any form. The reading life4238 was read whole; it is one of the two lives this day gives at any length. The day page prints no hymn under his name. The reading names no monastery and no place but «египетскую пустыню», the Egyptian desert, so no `locations` were written and the epithet is the whole of the geography.
